question: What is the largest dispatcher concurrency in 1, 2, or 4 that keeps live transcript lag and memory below the frozen gates?

production_path.service: one locally-started FastAPI process with live routes enabled
production_path.decoder: the real MOSS decoder through the production LiveServiceRuntime path
production_path.audio: real human speech replayed at wall-clock rate

latency.aggregation: compute each session independently; the run value is the maximum session p95
latency.rationale: with the deployed 2.5-second span cap, this leaves 7.5 seconds for queueing, decode, publish, and the included observer poll while remaining a live transcript

memory.rationale: retain 5 percent of vLLM cache headroom and reject per-session model duplication larger than 4 GiB above the warmed shared-model baseline

metric_definitions.transcript_lag_seconds: observer monotonic time of canonical_processed minus the replay-clock time of that span's end_sample; the 250 ms event-poll interval remains included
metric_definitions.real_time_factor: sum canonical_decode_elapsed_sec divided by sum frozen_span_duration_sec
metric_definitions.queue_depth: per-session pending_work_items sampled on every frame response and every event poll
metric_definitions.fairness: full canonical_started order; among sessions continuously ready during a completed round, maximum dispatch-count minus minimum dispatch-count
metric_definitions.vllm_active_and_queued: raw locally-run vLLM metrics exposition plus the active and queued request series sampled at least once per second
metric_definitions.memory: peak locally-started service and inference process-tree RSS minus warmed-idle RSS, plus peak vLLM GPU-cache-usage fraction
metric_definitions.errors: all non-success frame responses, terminal failures, GPU OOMs, and accelerator errors retained verbatim

selection_rule.rule: choose the largest candidate whose candidate-count meeting run and 10-minute soak pass latency, memory, fairness, zero-OOM, and cross-session integrity gates
selection_rule.eight_meeting_role: overload evidence only; it must retain cross-session integrity and demonstrate independent per-session 429 backpressure, but its latency does not select the normal bound
